snippet.title: We're All In! - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Showcasing some of the myriad minigames, please enjoy this gameplay trailer from the Black Lantern Team!

Minigame Party Madness! Inspired by legendary games like Mario Party, Party Animals & Fall Guys, We're All In is a brand new friendslop title that'll pit you against your friends in PVP & Co-Op Madness!

All the minigames with none of the board-om. WE’RE ALL IN! pits you against your friends in high-stakes bets on who will emerge victorious in a wide variety of minigames, including 1v1s, team modes, and free-for-alls.
